summary: v5 correctly lands the tagged input union, removes invented preview digests, separates native URI roles, repairs the split-fixture pointers, and preserves the preview/G17/D9/authority limits. Acceptance still fails at one blocker and one SHOULD-FIX: inputNotProduced permits sarif+ACTIVE with no truthful reason or state binding, and native location indices/order remain ambiguous.

blockers.title: The tagged union lets a golden self-declare a false not-produced outcome
detail: inputNotProduced independently permits advertisement='sarif' and dr006Standing='ACTIVE'. That is exactly the applicability state required by inputProduced (apart from the author-selected variant and real canonical input), yet the not-produced arm requires neither a reason-bearing precondition nor a proof that emission was not requested.

For the allowed sarif+ACTIVE not-produced state, neither expected reason is truthful: preview-not-advertised is false and dr006-inactive is false. The schema contains no conditional mapping from advertisement/dr006Standing to variant and expected.reason, so a fixture author can select variant='not-produced', pair it with either false reason, and make the pass rule demand no SARIF document.

The v4 untagged-input defect is mechanically repaired, but the new discriminator is self-asserted rather than derived or validated. That makes a negative golden capable of suppressing the very produced branch the contract is meant to test once DR-006 activates.
blockers.impact: opensip-sarif-golden.1 can encode contradictory input/outcome pairs and bless absence of an advertised, active projection. OBL-1/OBL-3 conformance remains non-deterministic despite the structurally valid preview fixtures.
blockers.minimumRepair: Define and enforce the input/outcome truth table: advertisement=none selects not-produced with preview-not-advertised; advertisement=sarif with DR-006 inactive selects only the explicitly lawful inactive result; advertisement=sarif with DR-006 active and a real pinned input selects produced. Bind expected.reason to the selected state, or add any genuinely distinct no-emission axis and reason explicitly. Do not invent a digest or identity recipe.

shouldFix.title: Native URI roles are separated but their array indices and ordering remain ambiguous
shouldFix.detail: The repair correctly separates primaryLocationUri from relatedLocationUri and forbids placing one URI in both roles. However, placementRule calls a result 'i' and then writes its primary URI at result.locations[i], conflating result identity with the location-array index; it also assigns additional URIs to distinct j values without defining their order. Multiple primary or related URIs can therefore be permuted or indexed differently by two renderers while both satisfy the rule.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Use distinct result and location indices and define a deterministic order for each locations/relatedLocations array (for example, preserved canonical host order or an explicitly owned stable sort key). Keep NFC comparison per entry and the one-URI-one-role rule.

obligationReview.reason: The advertised/active state can still be placed in the not-produced union arm with no truthful expected reason, so applicability does not determine emission.
Native primary and related URI paths now have distinct roles, but multiple entries still lack distinct index variables and deterministic array order.
A golden can self-select no output for the produced precondition, and renderer array permutations remain possible even after role separation.
The non-authority law and split TERM/COVERAGE fixtures retain correct standings, rides, and exact operative references.
The exact host-finalization, committed-Run/no-Run, operational-failed, error-code, and exit-derivation boundary remains correctly cited and distinct from both non-authority fixtures.
